messages.text: Looking for place to download hammer dc06 firmware.  It came with version 2.0.0 20260317

Harlo OS downloads, release notes and guides are all at https://harlolabs.com/ , grab the latest build for the DC06 there. Yours is on 2.0.0 20260317, so check it against the newest release listed for your model before anything else; most odd readings and missing features come from an older build.

If you want hands-on help flashing it, our Discord is the fastest route: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , post in the Harlo OS channel and mention @nullhashrate (JD).
I was looking for copy of what came with it not the Harlow os
